title: Junior Software Engineer
description: Develop and maintain web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and React. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions. Participate in code reviews and agile ceremonies.

title: Data Analyst
description: Analyze large datasets to extract business insights. Build dashboards and reports using Power BI and Tableau. Work with stakeholders to define KPIs and data-driven strategies.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Design and deploy machine learning models at scale. Work with large datasets, build training pipelines, and optimize model performance. Collaborate with product teams to integrate ML into production systems.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Build responsive and performant user interfaces for one of India's largest e-commerce platforms. Work with React, TypeScript, and modern CSS frameworks. Optimize for mobile-first experiences.

title: Backend Developer
description: Build and scale payment processing systems handling millions of transactions. Design RESTful APIs, manage databases, and ensure system reliability. Work with Go, Python, or Java.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automate infrastructure provisioning and deployment pipelines. Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS. Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting systems. Support development teams with CI/CD.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Develop end-to-end web applications for enterprise clients. Work across frontend (React/Angular) and backend (Node.js/Java). Participate in client-facing discussions and solution design.

title: Data Scientist
description: Apply statistical methods and machine learning to solve complex business problems. Build predictive models, conduct A/B tests, and communicate findings to stakeholders. Work with Azure ML and Python.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Design and implement cloud solutions on AWS and Azure. Migrate on-premise systems to cloud. Manage infrastructure security, cost optimization, and compliance.

title: AI Research Intern
description: Contribute to cutting-edge AI research projects. Implement and experiment with novel architectures. Write research papers and present findings. Work with JAX/TensorFlow on large-scale models.

title: Product Manager
description: Own product roadmap for consumer-facing features. Analyze user data to identify opportunities. Work with engineering and design teams to ship features. Define success metrics and measure outcomes.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Monitor and respond to security incidents. Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing. Implement security best practices and compliance frameworks. Analyze logs and threat intelligence.

title: Mobile App Developer
description: Develop and maintain mobile applications for Android and iOS. Implement new features, optimize performance, and fix bugs. Work with cross-platform frameworks and native SDKs.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Build natural language processing systems for enterprise products. Work on text classification, entity extraction, and conversational AI. Deploy models in production with low-latency requirements.

title: Database Administrator
description: Manage and optimize database systems for enterprise clients. Handle backups, replication, performance tuning, and security. Work with Oracle, PostgreSQL, and MySQL databases.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Design intuitive user interfaces for SaaS products. Conduct user research, create wireframes and prototypes, and collaborate with developers. Follow design systems and accessibility guidelines.

title: MLOps Engineer
description: Build and maintain ML infrastructure and pipelines. Automate model training, evaluation, and deployment. Manage experiment tracking and model registry. Ensure reliability of ML systems in production.

title: Embedded Systems Engineer
description: Design and develop firmware for IoT and consumer electronics devices. Work with C/C++, RTOS, and communication protocols. Debug hardware-software integration issues.

title: Blockchain Developer
description: Build decentralized applications and smart contracts. Work with Ethereum, Solidity, and Web3 frameworks. Optimize gas costs and ensure smart contract security.

title: Technical Writer
description: Write technical documentation for developer tools and APIs. Create tutorials, guides, and reference documentation. Collaborate with engineering teams to understand features and communicate them clearly.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description: Design and implement automated testing frameworks. Write test scripts for web and API testing. Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines. Work with development teams in an agile environment.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Develop computer vision models for autonomous systems and edge devices. Work with object detection, segmentation, and tracking. Optimize models for real-time inference on GPUs.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Ensure reliability and uptime of large-scale distributed systems. Build automation tools, manage incident response, and optimize system performance. Work with microservices at massive scale.

title: GenAI Application Developer
description: Build enterprise AI applications using LLMs and generative AI. Implement RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and AI agents. Work with AWS Bedrock, LangChain, and vector databases.

title: Data Engineer
description: Build and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes. Design data warehouse schemas and optimize query performance. Work with big data technologies to process millions of events daily.
